ashley: Heads-up — Starlight private VPC cutover is locked for Tue 2026-04-06 22:00-23:00 PDT (UTC-7). Main asks: who owns smoke checks, who's on rollback, and any last-minute CRs?

Tariq: I can own smoke tests and post results. I'll be on call from 21:45 PT. Please @me if you need immediate rollback.

Ash: @tariq awesome. Can you confirm the smoke checklist you're running and expected signal thresholds? e.g., 2xx rate > 99%, p95 < 300ms for auth svc.

Tariq: Yep — plan below. Short enough to run during the window.

Tariq: ```
# quick smoke steps
curl -fsS https://starlight-internal.healthz | jq .status
kubectl -n starlight rollout status deploy/api --timeout=90s\# run a few sample LLM calls to verify prefix cache warmup\curl -X POST https://starlight-api.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .choices
```

Leo: I'll own rollback and infra-level checks. If anything fails we revert the new control-plane config and rollback web/api deployments. Rollback steps (abridged):

Leo: ```
# rollback (high level)
kubectl -n starlight rollout undo deploy/api
kubectl -n starlight rollout undo deploy/web
# if infra-config change: terraform apply -target=module.starlight_control_plane --auto-approve
```

Anya: I'll coordinate traffic shift and monitor RL metrics in the console (latency, token cost, error rates). Planning a 5% canary for first 10 minutes then 25% -> 100% if green.

Ash: No expected DB migration in this cutover, right? I want to avoid schema touches during the window.

Leo: Correct — no schema changes. Only control-plane and runtime config (cache ttl, batching).

deploy-bot: Scheduled cutover task created: job-id: starlight-20260406-22z, organizer=@ashley, approvers=[leo,anya]. Reminder ping 30m before.

Tariq: Quick note on warmup — we should pre-warm dedicated GPU cache for top 5 models ~15m before start to avoid cold-start spikes. I'll trigger warmup at 21:45 PT.

Anya: Added small synthetic traffic generator job to console with these endpoints and checks. Link: https://console.redwood/internal/jobs/58723 (internal)

Ash: One last CR: @eng-runtime FYI — please confirm quantization profile used in this rollout matches the Canary profile. We don't want any sudden perf regressions.

Tariq: I'll validate model variants on the canary after deploy. If mismatch, hold and rollback.

Leo: Escalation path: if smoke fails and rollback doesn't restore 2xx rate in 10m, we involve platform oncall (@dana) and prepare a hotfix branch.

Ash: Who's monitoring alerts? Anya? And can we get a small incident channel created for the window?

Anya: I'll create #starlight-cutover and invite oncall + SRE 15m before.

Tariq: Quick ask — is there a backup snapshot for cache and state? Need to know if prefix cache clear is safe.

Leo: There's a KV snapshot taken at 21:40 PT automatically by job 58720. If needed we can restore but it is manual and will take ~8-12m.

Ash: Cool. Final checklist for the thread: 1) @tariq smoke owner; 2) @leo rollback owner; 3) @anya traffic + monitoring; 4) deploy-bot scheduled + reminder; 5) pre-warm at 21:45 PT. Anything else?

Anya: I'll post the smoke checklist and a one-click rollback link in #starlight-cutover 20m before.

Leo: I'll be standing by in the channel from 21:30 PT.

Tariq: Same. I'll push a tiny smoke harness to the runbook in case we need to replay tests quickly.

Ash: thanks all — closing this thread. Ping in #starlight-cutover for live updates. :thumbsup:
